titulo: Etsy (Dec 2023): $576.9 million buying back its own stock, about 225 jobs planned cuts. The math.
caption:
From the archive: Dec 2023. Not today's news.
Etsy, Dec 13, 2023 (Etsy, Form 8-K): "better align Etsy’s workforce and cost structure with current business needs"
Etsy said in an SEC filing on Dec. 13, 2023 that its board approved a restructuring plan that cuts about 225 employees, 11% of its marketplace workforce. The buyback figure is from its 2023 Form 10-K.

Same year: $576.9 million buying back its own stock, 2023, company-wide. $576,968 thousand of stock repurchased during 2023, company-wide (cash flow statement, Form 10-K, reported in thousands).
The math: $576.9 million in buybacks (2023) ÷ about 225 job cuts = about $2.5 million in buybacks per planned job cut.
This is a ratio, not a payment and not a cause: the total spent on buybacks divided by the job count. The $576.968 million is Etsy's stock repurchases for all of 2023, company-wide. The 225 employees are about 11% of the marketplace workforce, per the filing, not the whole company. We are not saying one paid for the other.

Aligned with business needs. The buyback column was busy too. (Our take.)

For someone whose workforce was once better aligned.

Sources: SEC EDGAR · Etsy, Dec 13, 2023; SEC EDGAR · Etsy, Feb 22, 2024.

Swipe: the sentence, the number, the math, our take.
